$comment: Golden set seeded from the maintainer's real queries (2026-09-06). Ground truth marked `confirmed: false` still needs a human decision. Half of these cases are NEGATIVE: they must produce no_local_result rather than an answer assembled from irrelevant top-k.

cases.query:
意靜不隨流水轉
心閒遠與雲俱
cases.note: Not in the corpus as a work, but 不隨流水 matches a 4-character run in 宗亮《禮舍利塔》(有客不隨流水去). The system correctly reports local_low_confidence rather than claiming that poem — the distinction §7.4 insists on. Confirmed as a negative for attribution purposes.

expect.title: 送司馬入京
expect.author: 杜甫
expect.corpusText: 羣盜至今日，先朝忝從臣。歎君能戀主，久客羨歸秦。黃閣長司諫，丹墀有故人。向來論社稷，爲話涕霑巾。

cases.note: RESOLVED against the corpus: 杜甫《送司馬入京》, recovered by reading lines bottom-to-top. NOTE A TEXTUAL VARIANT: the pasted text reads 羣盜至今在／先朝赤子存／君王猶戀主 where this corpus reads 羣盜至今日／先朝忝從臣／歎君能戀主. Lines 3-8 agree exactly. Per §10.3 both readings should be shown rather than one silently chosen — this case is the regression test for that.

cases.query:
地何病著名涌平夜岸細
一所休官章江野舟危草
沙似老應文大闊星檣微
鷗天飄飄豈流月垂獨風
cases.note: RESOLVED against the corpus via grid_rtl at cols=10, in ~57ms. Five distinct lines of 旅夜書懷 matched. A second work ties on longest run — 張元幹《水調歌頭》, which quotes 天地一沙鷗 from this very poem — but explains only one line, so the tie-break on window breadth resolves it. That allusion is real signal and stays in the candidate list as evidence.

cases.query:
辛亥月
鶴舞飛翔
己亥年
cases.note: NEGATIVE CASE. A calligraphy signature block: 干支 cyclical date plus a title. Not verse at all. 辛亥月 is also malformed as a date — 干支 months are rare and this pairs a stem-branch month with a different stem-branch year.
NEGATIVE CASE. Four-character calligraphy title in isolation. Below the 5-character short-circuit threshold of §7.1, so it must not short-circuit.
